mapper.sql: SELECT app_user.user_id AS reviewer_id, app_user.user_name AS reviewer_name, app_user.email, app_user.organization_id, organization.organization_name, ( SELECT MIN(app_role.role_name) FROM user_role JOIN app_role ON app_role.role_id = user_role.role_id AND app_role.is_deleted = 0 WHERE user_role.user_id = app_user.user_id AND user_role.is_deleted = 0 ) AS role_name FROM app_user JOIN organization ON organization.organization_id = app_user.organization_id AND organization.is_deleted = 0 WHERE app_user.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND app_user.active_yn = 'Y' AND app_user.is_deleted = 0 AND app_user.email IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(app_user.email) IS NOT NULL
